expression_layer.values: per-cell library-size normalized to 10000 then ceiled; not unmodified UMI
expression_layer.exact_cell_aggregation: sum ceiled normalized values within donor x harmonized cell type divided by eligible cell count

eligibility.gene_filter: donor mean normalized expression >0 in >=3 eligible donor summaries, without disease-label-dependent filtering

gene_model.input: continuous log2 donor mean normalized expression
gene_model.fdr: BH within cell type and contrast

gene_sets.method: cameraPR on signed corrected limma moderated t statistics
gene_sets.tier1_fdr: BH within the 20 frozen hypotheses separately for EOPE and LOPE
gene_sets.tier2_fdr: BH across the combined frozen three-collection universe within cell type and contrast

tier1_classification.CORRECTED_SHARED_SUPPORT: legacy direction agrees and BH FDR<0.05 in both EOPE and LOPE
tier1_classification.EOPE_ONLY_SUPPORT: legacy direction agrees and BH FDR<0.05 in EOPE, but not LOPE
tier1_classification.LOPE_ONLY_SUPPORT: legacy direction agrees and BH FDR<0.05 in LOPE, but not EOPE
tier1_classification.DIRECTION_ONLY: legacy direction agrees in both EOPE and LOPE, with neither subtype BH FDR<0.05
tier1_classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: any other pattern, including an opposite direction in either subtype without qualifying one-subtype support

tier2_classification.CORRECTED_SHARED_PE: EOPE and LOPE BH FDR<0.05 with concordant effect direction
tier2_classification.CORRECTED_EOPE_ENRICHED: EOPE BH FDR<0.05 and LOPE BH FDR>=0.10 or not estimable
tier2_classification.CORRECTED_LOPE_ENRICHED: LOPE BH FDR<0.05 and EOPE BH FDR>=0.10 or not estimable
tier2_classification.CORRECTED_UNSTABLE: opposite subtype directions when either is significant, or single-subtype significance with other subtype FDR in [0.05,0.10)

module_rule.corrected_admati_support: >=50% of constituent sets agree with the legacy direction in both subtypes and >=1 constituent has Tier-1 FDR<0.05 in either subtype
module_rule.directional_only: >=50% of constituent sets agree in both subtypes but no constituent has Tier-1 FDR<0.05
module_rule.not_supported: fewer than 50% of constituents agree in both subtypes
module_rule.LEVEL_A: corrected Admati support plus independent external single-cell directional support
module_rule.LEVEL_B: corrected Admati support but external single-cell is not evaluable
module_rule.phase2b_candidate: LEVEL_A or LEVEL_B with corrected Admati support; no bulk evidence is consulted

zheng_pass_conditions: EOPE/control labels and elective C-section status attributable to each donor
no unresolved contradiction that invalidates the EOPE estimand
external_validation.zheng_failure_action: write NOT_RUN rows with reason; do not manufacture targeted statistics
external_validation.yang: preserve Phase 2A.1 values unchanged; mechanically update evidence labels only
